spec.name: Neon Rider Arcade Cabinet
spec.description: A 1980s upright arcade cabinet rebuilt in synthwave style: dark purple cabinet, glowing neon marquee and side art, a lit CRT screen and a chrome-trimmed control deck.
spec.layout: A classic upright arcade cabinet standing on the floor, facing +Z: a tall tapered plywood-style body whose front leans back in three planes. From front to back: a sloping control deck at the front top (y ~0.82-1.0) holding a joystick and two button banks, behind it a recessed CRT screen (y ~0.95-1.5) sunk into the cabinet with a deep bezel, above that a speaker grille strip, and at the very top an angled marquee window (y ~1.5-1.82) tilted back about 15 degrees glowing with the game's neon title art. The lower front (y 0-0.85) carries the coin door and a black kick plate; the back is a plain angled panel. The synthwave style shows everywhere: deep purple and violet shell colours, neon pink/cyan/orange sunset stripes and a perspective grid drawn as small parts on the marquee, screen bezel and side panels, chrome T-molding and trim strips seated along every edge, a glowing cyan scanline screen and glowing marquee, pink ball-top joystick and coloured buttons.

parts.builds: The main cabinet shell built from frustumBox/loft volumes: the full upright body from y=0 to the marquee top at y=1.82, tapering slightly from the wide base to the top, with the three-step leaning front profile (control-deck ledge at y~0.95, recessed screen cavity, angled marquee header), a solid back panel that leans back toward the top, and an open front where the screen, deck and coin-door parts sit. Include the outer plywood faces in hullPurple with hullDark interior visible in the screen cavity recess, a chrome T-molding strip run along the two front vertical edges and the marquee perimeter as thin seated parts, and small vent slits (thin dark boxes) in the back panel. The hull also owns a simple dark plinth/shadow base so the shell reads grounded. No side art here - side panels are a separate part.
parts.attaches: Owns the whole footprint; screenAssembly, controlDeck and coinDoor build into its front recesses at screenPlane, deckShelf and coinPanelTop; sideArtL/R sit proud of sideFaceR.

parts.builds: The lit face of the cabinet: a recessed CRT screen assembly and the top marquee. The CRT is a slightly curved dark screenGlow panel (glow() it) inside a screenBlack bezel with chrome edging, sitting in the hull cavity with a drawn scanline effect made of a few thin darker horizontal bars seated on the glass; the bezel surround carries neon pink and cyan stripe trims and small corner screws in coinSteel. Above the screen, a speaker grille strip (a dark plate with a grid of small holes as tiny parts or a perforated texture) flanked by two chrome speaker rings. The marquee is an angled window panel tilted back ~15 degrees: a marqueeBlack frame holding a glowing synthwave artwork built from parts - a big setting sun of concentric neonPink/orange/yellow bands, a perspective grid of neonCyan lines receding toward the horizon, and a chrome-edged game title bar - all glow() lit, with a thin chrome frame and a small top cap.
parts.attaches: Sits recessed into the hull front cavity at screenPlane and marqueeBase; its grille strip meets the hull ledge at speakerStrip.

parts.builds: The sloping player deck: a sloped panel (roughly 12 degrees down toward the front) from deckShelf to deckFrontEdge, wearing a chrome-edged plate in hullPurple with a thin neonCyan inlay line around its edge and a sunset stripe (orange/yellow/pink thin bars) along its front lip. On it: a full joystick assembly on the left side - a chromeDark base plate, a chrome shaft and a big neonPink ball top (glow it softly) - and a six-button bank on the right arranged in two rows of three (alternating buttonRed and buttonWhite round buttons seated in dark recessed rims), plus a small start/pair of white coin-buttons near the front edge with tiny labels. Include the deck's chrome side rails and a small front overhang trim piece.
parts.attaches: Rear edge seats onto the hull shelf at deckShelf, front edge overhangs above the coin panel at deckFrontEdge.

parts.builds: The lower front of the cabinet: a slightly recessed lower front panel in hullPurple spanning from y=0.1 to y=0.85, carrying a coin door assembly centred low - a coinSteel-framed door plate in chromeDark with a coin return slot, a small lock circle and two coin slots side by side each with a glowing neonPink price plate above them. Above the door, a wide neonCyan trim strip and the start of the cabinet's side stripe running down. The bottom 0-0.1 is a kickBlack kick plate with a thin chrome cap strip on top and a faint maroon scuff strip. Add two small castor feet or a levelled base plinth in kickBlack at the corners.
parts.attaches: Fills the hull's lower front face, top edge meeting the control deck front overhang at coinPanelTop and the hull side edges; bottom rests on the floor with the hull plinth at kickBase.

parts.builds: The signature synthwave side art: two large flat panels, one per side, standing a few centimetres proud of the hull sides (x = +/-0.435), each a deep purple/violet field carrying a full synthwave scene built from parts - a big sun of horizontal neon bands (pink, orange, yellow) sitting on a horizon line, a neonCyan perspective grid floor of receding lines below it, a few tall chrome-dark grid mountains, and a small chrome starfield of dots. A vertical neonPink stripe runs down the panel's rear edge and thin chrome T-molding trims the panel's outer perimeter. Both panels mirror each other; keep them flat and crisp so the silhouette reads from the side.
parts.attaches: Both panels mount flush against the hull's side faces at sideFaceR (mirror for -x), sitting inside the cabinet's width so the deck and kick plate edges remain visible.
